verifiedImmediateEffect.verificationScope: Named NARA/USDC balances, both named LP NFT owners and liquidity, and the sealed NARA reserve were unchanged from the pinned pre-execution snapshot.

maturityPolicy.ifReplacementIsNotReady: Leave the matured recovery pending and leave both old LP positions active. Time passage alone is not authority to withdraw.
maturityPolicy.doNotRepropose: Re-proposing overwrites the pending recovery and restarts the seven-day delay. Do not re-run or re-import the Stage-0 proposal artifact.
maturityPolicy.doNotExecuteRecoveryAlone: executeRecovery() transfers only the compounder NFT and bank to the Safe. It does not decrease either LP NFT or drain the old vault.

replacementScope.name: NARA V5 complete-stack redeployment
replacementScope.meaning: A genuinely new protocol stack, including a new token, engine, reserve, protocol periphery, liquidity stack, pool, custody and operational integrations

v4RecoverySourceOnly.rule: These are current v4 addresses to recover from and retire, not retained V5 components. Stage 0 grants no authority over the engine or sealed reserve.

replacementScope.oneHourRule: One hour is permitted only on a disposable non-public V5 rehearsal deployment, which must be retired before a fresh production deployment.

operatorWarnings: This file records a completed human Safe action; it is not a transaction payload and grants no broadcast authority.
The source proposal artifact is historical executed evidence. Do not import or execute it again.
The old source pool remains active and can trade during the delay, so every balance, fee, price, and withdrawal estimate must be recomputed at one fresh block before cutover.
Do not finalize the pending 0.75%/1%/2% old-hook fee curve.
Do not treat the current v4 token, engine, or reserve addresses as V5. V5 requires new reviewed source, fresh addresses, manifests and explicit human deployment approval.
Stage 0 authorizes only the old v4 compounder recovery clock. It does not authorize V5 deployment, old-engine shutdown, reserve movement, token migration or V5 mint/allocation decisions.
The v4 liquidity withdrawal must be one separately reviewed, exact-fork-simulated, atomic Safe transaction. V5 deployment and seeding require their own complete-stack plan and approvals.
